# Node Dependency Issue

## Problem

An artifact-shaped file planted inside an installed npm dependency tree. Nothing
in this repository authored it; it is here to prove that a third-party tree's
artifact-shaped files stay out of the consumer's corpus because a pack declares
`node_modules`, not because core knows the noun.

It is a VALID, parseable artifact on purpose: an unparseable file would make
`artifact validate` return a config error on the first file it discovers, so the
wiring tests' degraded rows would assert on a parse diagnostic instead of on the
per-artifact record set — a fragile signal that would also mask a genuine wiring
regression behind an exit-2.
